name: cea-os
description: Cyber Elias Academy Digital Operating System

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w packages/validators && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w workers/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w workers/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w workers/api
